Specifically, we propose to optimize the GSR procedure by choosing its head start and detection threshold so as to bring the lower bound as far up as is possible within the set tolerable Average Run Length (ARL) to false alarm level. We then follow through with this idea and carry out a case study where, in a specific exponential scenario, we solve the respective lower bound-vs-ARL tradeoff numerically, and tabulate the obtained optimal head start, detection threshold, and the maximized lower bound.
